metadata.description: Open source Claude Code skills for planning a Looker to Omni migration: explore ERDs, dashboard lineage, materialization review and a LookML to Omni converter.

plugins.name: looker-omni-migration
plugins.description: Plan a Looker to Omni migration before you move a single explore. Risk-scored LookML explore ERDs, dashboard to explore to view lineage, warehouse materialization review, a converter from LookML views and explores to Omni model files, and a Looker System Activity query for sizing and finding UGC dashboards.
